query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.imageUrl,
       ds.id as dataSourceId, ds.source, ds.sourceIdentifier, ds.sourceUrl, ds.lastUpdatedAt
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN dataSources ds ON c.id = ds.cardId
WHERE c.id = 180009;
